I will buy some DAP and urea from the cooperative to apply on this plot, and I will also spread manure that I have saved from my animals. I plan to use improved maize seed because it grows better when I use fertilizer, and I do not see a need for chemicals to kill insects or weeds on such a small piece of land. My family will do the planting, weeding, and harvesting, but I might hire a couple of young men for two days when the weeding is heavy.
